decisions.title: Zero personal income tax for both parents at three dependent children
decisions.official_reasons: Households that raise three dependent children while married or common-law together carry the long bill of the nation. The tax code will not treat that household as a cash cow. Deep deductions apply on the path at one and two children. Both parents zero-rated on personal income tax at three — not one parent only. Funded by waste cuts and health-load redesign first, not fairy-dust deficits.

udl.citizen_test: Safer/smarter/stronger/richer for citizens and their children: yes — more take-home for nation-building households; next generation better funded by parents.
udl.steelman_for: Fertility and family formation are national capacity. High tax on dual earners with kids is self-sabotage. Clear cliff at three is simple to administer and honest to advertise.
udl.steelman_against: Fiscal cost is large; childless taxpayers subsidize; fertility response may be modest; complexity and fraud risk at the margin of 'dependent'.
udl.foreign_interest: No foreign state gain. Domestic political risk only.
udl.history: Prior baby bonuses without dual-parent zero and without waste cuts failed the ledger. This pairs tax power with Open State savings.

ai.prompt: Run Universal Decision Logic on: federal zero personal income tax for BOTH parents when three dependent children and married/common-law together. Steelman for and against from all spectrum extremes. Use only citizen outcomes, fiscal arithmetic, and history of family transfers. No political branding. Flag foreign interest. Recommend adopt/pilot/reject.
ai.analysis:
VALID STRUCTURE: If nation needs more stable multi-child households and current PIT burdens dual earners with kids, then reducing PIT at a clear threshold is a coherent tool.

FOR: Simplicity beats opaque credit mazes; dual-parent zero is the distinctive load-bearing rule; aligns incentives with long-run citizen stock.

AGAINST: Score the gross fiscal hole against PIT base (~public $238B-class personal take — order of magnitude). Without concurrent waste destruction and health redesign, debt rises — fails hard-dollar non-negotiable.

DATA: Fertility elasticities to tax are real but not infinite; treat as B-grade. Require annual published cost and uptake.

FOREIGN: None material.

RECOMMEND: ADOPT only sequenced after Open State waste path is live; sunset review at year 5 if uptake and solvency miss KPI.

decisions.council: named oversight: approve with mandatory fiscal sequence (ledger savings path visible). Dissent noted on cliff effects at child 2→3.
decisions.outcome: Adopted. Systems change under Trace T-DEMO-031. Public scoreboard required annually.

decisions.title: Mandatory National Service Year replaces grade 10
decisions.official_reasons: Grade 10 becomes one year of mandatory national service: military-style training, not combat deployment. Streams mostly sex-separated so trainees work instead of dating drama. Early rise, fitness, standards, real consequences. Grade 11–12 and post-secondary continue after. Purpose: cut bad habits before the years that decide university and trades; build a generation that keeps time and finishes work.

udl.citizen_test: Stronger and more orderly next generation of citizens; higher completion discipline before advanced school.
udl.steelman_for: Habit window closes after mid-teens. Soft school discipline fails many, especially boys at peak hormones. Shared hard standards raise national cohesion and lower chaos costs later (crime, dropout, unemployability).
udl.steelman_against: Charter and provincial education power risk; cost; uneven quality of cadres; risk of abuse in institutions; some academic interruption; political backlash.
udl.foreign_interest: None material. Allied training models informative only.
udl.history: Countries with service traditions show cohesion gains when training is serious and not politicized theatre. Poorly run camps fail — publish kill criteria.

ai.prompt: UDL on replacing grade 10 with mandatory military-style national service (no combat deployment), mostly sex-separated training, then grade 11–12. Steelman all spectrum extremes. Include boy/girl developmental differences only where evidence supports training design. Charter risk flag. Adopt/pilot/reject.
ai.analysis:
LOGIC: If (a) habit formation peaks mid-teens and (b) classroom-only environments produce preventable failure modes and (c) later remediation is costlier, then a structured service year before grade 11–12 is a rational intervention — provided academics resume and abuse controls are real.

SEX SEPARATION: Training design to reduce distraction is not a moral essay; it is an efficiency claim. Mixed modules can remain for shared skills if evidence supports.

AGAINST: Rights litigation, cost, cadre quality. Without rigorous instructor standards this becomes trauma factory or summer camp — both fail UDL.

RECOMMEND: ADOPT in law with phased stand-up, public UDL, independent inspectorate, medical alternatives, and automatic review. Pilot metrics before full cohort size if counsel requires.

decisions.council: Council: approve design with inspectorate and Charter counsel memo public in summary. No combat deployment as product.
decisions.outcome: Adopted as program design. Ops Trace T-DEMO-021. Provincial delivery compact required.

decisions.title: Harm-tiered substance ages: psilocybin 21+; alcohol/smoking/LSD/MDMA/ketamine 25+
decisions.official_reasons: Ages follow harm, not fashion. Alcohol and smoked nicotine to 25. Psilocybin regulated at 21: low dependence/overdose risk relative to alcohol, with real evidence of benefit in defined clinical contexts — face facts, end the hypocrisy of legal high-harm drugs and total bans on lower-harm tools. LSD, MDMA, ketamine at 25 under purity and unit-dose rules. Smokeless tobacco 21. Street fentanyl and mystery analogues stay illegal as party supply.

udl.citizen_test: Reduce youth brain harm from high-harm drugs; cut black-market poison; allow adult access where evidence supports lower harm and benefit.
udl.steelman_for: Alcohol is legal and lethal at scale; consistency requires either honesty about harm tiers or total prohibition (which fails). Regulated psilocybin beats contaminated product. Purity rules for MDMA/LSD/ketamine at 25 reduce body-bag outcomes from mystery pills.
udl.steelman_against: Normalization risk; impaired driving; industry capture; medical evidence overclaimed by advocates; enforcement complexity.
udl.data_grade: B for relative harm rankings; B–C for population benefit claims — do not overclaim.
udl.foreign_interest: Watch foreign grey-market and pharma lobbying both ways.
udl.history: Prohibition of popular substances without harm ranking produces black markets. Age gates must be enforced to mean anything.

ai.prompt: Compare alcohol, nicotine (smoked vs smokeless), cannabis, psilocybin, LSD, MDMA, ketamine on dependence, overdose, violence, and developing-brain risk. Propose age tiers for Canada under citizens-first UDL. No moral fashion. Cite uncertainty. Recommend legal architecture: ban vs regulate.
ai.analysis:
HARM ORDER (population): alcohol and smoked nicotine dominate death and social cost. Psilocybin dependence/OD risk is far lower; therapeutic signal exists in depression/addiction/end-of-life distress under controlled use — still not a toy.

TIERING: 25 for high social-cost recreational intoxicants (alcohol, smoked nicotine, cannabis, LSD/MDMA/ketamine). 21 for psilocybin and smokeless tobacco with ad bans and purity.

HYPocrisy TEST: Keeping alcohol at 18/19 while banning lower-harm psychedelics fails non-contradiction.

RECOMMEND: ADOPT tiers + purity labs + no youth ads + impaired driving enforcement. Publish evidence grades annually; strip marketing claims that exceed data.

decisions.council: Council: adopt tiers; medical claims must stay inside evidence grade. Pregnancy zero-tolerance remains.
decisions.outcome: Adopted. Lab and tracking budget T-DEMO-040.

decisions.title: Ban commercial and public pornography; private non-commercial adult only
decisions.official_reasons: Industrial porn is not free speech fashion — it is a commercial aggression and addiction pipeline aimed at the young. Commercial production, sale, and public platforms banned in Canada. Private non-commercial adult possession/use among adults only, not publicly accessible. Non-consensual distribution remains a hard crime.

udl.citizen_test: Safer kids and young adults; less aggression and wasted hours; stronger families over time.
udl.steelman_for: Scale of exposure to minors via phones is a public-health and crime-adjacent problem. Commercial industry optimizes addiction. Public ban cuts supply and glamour.
udl.steelman_against: Charter expression risk; enforcement hard; black markets; overbreadth; adult liberty costs.
udl.data_grade: B for youth exposure and addiction patterns; causal claims on crime require careful wording.
udl.foreign_interest: Offshore platforms — need tech and payment enforcement.
udl.history: Ad bans and age gates without commercial ban leave the industry intact. Pair with gambling ad ban.

ai.prompt: UDL on commercial/public porn ban with private non-commercial adult exception. Steelman free-speech maximalism vs child-protection and social-cost arguments. Enforcement options. Charter-aware least-impairing design.
ai.analysis:
SPEECH: Commercial scale and algorithmic push differ from private adult acts. A ban aimed at industry and public distribution is narrower than banning private thought.

CHILD PROTECTION: Default phone access makes 'parental responsibility only' insufficient as sole tool.

ENFORCEMENT: Payment rails, hosting, and age-gate liability beat street vice squads.

RISK: Overbreadth and selective enforcement. Definitions must be precise.

RECOMMEND: ADOPT commercial/public ban; private non-commercial adult carve-out; harden NCII; independent oversight of enforcement. Charter memo public in summary.

decisions.council: Council: adopt with tight definitions and counsel summary public.

decisions.title: Full food disclosure + ban on ads for ultra-processed and unhealthy food
decisions.official_reasons: If the label lies, the body pays. Full public disclosure of what is in food. Ban advertising ultra-processed and clearly unhealthy food products — adults may still buy; we ban the industrial pitch that makes disease profitable. Healthy and whole food tax-favoured.

udl.citizen_test: Healthier citizens, lower preventable disease load, less tax for lifestyle disease.
udl.steelman_for: Kids cannot out-negotiate billion-dollar ad machines. Price and disclosure beat lectures alone.
udl.steelman_against: Trade law, definition fights, black-market ads, rural access, nanny-state critique.
udl.data_grade: A–B on ad effects on kids; B on long-run hospital savings.
udl.history: Tobacco-style ad limits worked on glamour; food is next largest preventable load.

ai.prompt: UDL on UPF/unhealthy food advertising ban plus full ingredient/process disclosure and tax favour for whole food. Steelman industry and liberty objections. Least-impairing design.
ai.analysis:
ADS ≠ PRODUCT BAN: Leaving products on shelves while ending mass persuasion is coherent and less impairing than prohibition.

DEFINITIONS: Must be objective (processing class, nutrient thresholds) to survive lobbying fog.

RECOMMEND: ADOPT ad ban + disclosure + tax skew; publish definition schedule; enforce digital and youth channels first.

decisions.council: Council: adopt; definition schedule to Parliament within 90 days of demo enactment.

decisions.title: Capacity-capped skilled intake; removals priority; citizens-first security screen
decisions.official_reasons: Intake tracks housing, hospitals, wages, and security capacity. Prefer high skill. Asylum is not a mass loophole. Violent non-citizens removed immediately. UDL applies: residual risk to Canadian citizens fails the citizen test.

udl.citizen_test: Protect wages, housing, hospital access, and physical security of citizens.
udl.steelman_for: Unlimited intake under scarcity is arithmetic fraud. Security and cohesion are public goods.
udl.steelman_against: Labour shortages; humanitarian duties; aging demographics; international reputation.
udl.data_grade: A on capacity constraints; B on skill-mix design.
udl.foreign_interest: Source-country pressure to export surplus risk — refuse when citizen risk high.
udl.history: Rapid population via temporary streams without housing failed service levels.

ai.prompt: UDL on Canadian immigration levels under housing/hospital/wage constraints. Include security screens for conflict-origin cohorts with documented violence risk. No fashion language. Recommend rules.
ai.analysis:
CAPACITY is a hard constraint: if housing completions and hospital seats do not rise, intake must fall — identity of applicants does not repeal arithmetic.

SECURITY: Origin conflict + hostile doctrine patterns raise expected risk; screening and caps are rational, not theatre.

RECOMMEND: ADOPT formula-tied levels, skill preference, fast removals for violent non-citizens, public capacity dashboard.

decisions.council: Council: adopt formula; publish dashboard quarterly.

decisions.title: REJECT: Renew failed consultant mega-contract (no KPI movement)
decisions.official_reasons: Prior spend of similar scope produced no movement on the named KPI. Ledger shows dollars to the same vendor class. Renewing is sunk-cost theatre. Reject; reallocate or save.

udl.citizen_test: Fail — no evidence citizens get safer/smarter/stronger/richer from renewal.
udl.steelman_for: Switching costs; vendor continuity; political embarrassment if cancelled.
udl.steelman_against: History of zero KPI movement; opportunity cost; Open State rules require kill.
udl.foreign_interest: Vendor may be multinational — irrelevant if value absent.
udl.history: Same program class failed two evaluation cycles.

ai.prompt: UDL on renewing a multi-year management consulting program after two cycles with flat KPIs and full Trace history. Recommend adopt/reject. No concern for ministerial face-saving.
ai.analysis:
IF prior $ did not move KPI and mechanism is unchanged, THEN expected value of renewal ≈ 0 under rational policy.

Face-saving is not a citizen outcome.

RECOMMEND: REJECT. Publish kill. Open waste bounty if citizens surface related shells.

decisions.council: Council: reject unanimous on fiscal grounds.
decisions.outcome: Rejected. Funds returned to surplus path / tax room. Example for citizen bounty education.
